# M'Brace Hospital by Kamineni Hospitals

> M'Brace is a women and child care hospital in Hyderabad, Telangana, run by Kamineni Hospitals Pvt. Ltd. It provides women's health, pregnancy and birth care, fertility treatment (IVF, IUI, ICSI) and paediatric and neonatal care, including NICU and PICU. It has two branches, LB Nagar and King Koti.

Key facts:

- Launched in January 2026 as a unit of Kamineni Hospitals, which has 34+ years of mother and child care experience and over 1,10,000 babies delivered.
- Facilities: Fetal Medicine Unit, 4D ultrasound, advanced LDR (labour-delivery-recovery) rooms, sterile operation theatres, robotic surgery, NICU, PICU, an advanced embryology lab and 24x7 emergency and transport.
- Emergencies involving pregnancy, newborns and children are assessed 24x7, including nights, Sundays and public holidays. Scheduled consultations run Monday to Saturday.
- Patients can use Kamineni Hospitals' diagnostics, surgery and critical-care services when they need them.
- General phone: +91 93906 34074 | Email: mbrace@kaminenihospitals.com

## Locations

- [M'Brace LB Nagar](https://mbracecare.com/locations/lb-nagar): Inner Ring Road, Suryodaya Colony, Central Bank Colony, Bahadurguda, Hyderabad, Telangana 500068. Phone +91 70362 70362.
- [M'Brace King Koti](https://mbracecare.com/locations/king-koti): Boggulakunta, King Koti, Abids, Hyderabad 500001. Phone +91 78159 78159.

## Care Areas

- [Women's Care](https://mbracecare.com/womens-care): Gynaecology, preventive health, maternity, menopause and laparoscopic surgery.
- [Pregnancy & Birth Support](https://mbracecare.com/pregnancy-birth-support): Antenatal care, fetal medicine, 4D ultrasound, LDR rooms and high-risk pregnancy support.
- [Fertility Care](https://mbracecare.com/fertility-care): Fertility evaluation, IVF, IUI, ICSI, egg freezing and male fertility care.
- [Child Care](https://mbracecare.com/child-care): Paediatrics, neonatology, NICU, PICU, paediatric surgery and paediatric emergency.
